verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a public REST API that can be used through an SDK or direct HTTP requests. Access tokens authenticate it and can be scoped to an account, team or project. A live probe confirms the published OpenAPI description at vercel.com/openapi.json. Agents can find the API through llms.txt guidance, which points to the OpenAPI spec and auth docs, and through the live ai-catalog.json, which lists the REST API. Webhooks add event-driven integration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving operations through the API (the probes only confirm the spec exists), and detail on endpoint coverage or rate limits in the pack.
